depts.name: Executive Office
depts.purpose: Sets priorities, runs the team, owns your approval queue.

depts.name: Research & Analytics
depts.purpose: Finds what works in the market and measures what works for Ola.
depts.kpi: KPI: share of posts above median reach

depts.name: Content Studio
depts.purpose: Plans, writes and edits every piece of content in your voice.

depts.name: Publishing
depts.purpose: Schedules approved content on every channel.

depts.name: Paid Media
depts.purpose: Runs paid campaigns on Google, Meta, TikTok, LinkedIn and X inside your budget.

depts.name: Compliance & Brand
depts.purpose: Checks every claim and ad against official sources and the CAP Code.

depts.name: Sales & Growth
depts.purpose: Finds Ltd-company leads, answers enquiries and books consultations.

depts.name: Website & Blog
depts.purpose: Keeps ola-accountancy.co.uk accurate and publishes one verified article a week.
depts.kpi: KPI: 1 article/week · 0 outdated facts on site

agents.name: Chief of Staff
agents.title: AI Chief of Staff of the department
agents.task: Compiling Tuesday brief: 4 approvals waiting for you.
agents.role: Runs the marketing department day to day as your Chief of Staff: sets priorities for the seven department heads, keeps the task queue and brings you only what needs your decision. Reports to you.
inputs: Reports from the seven department heads
agents.gate: Cannot approve content, ad spend or outreach on your behalf. Escalates anything new, risky or off-brand.

agents.name: Head of Research
agents.title: Market and competitor research
agents.task: Scanning Instagram and TikTok for outlier videos on MTD for Income Tax.
agents.role: Finds UK accountancy and small-business posts that perform far above normal, and explains why they worked.

agents.name: Data Analyst
agents.title: Performance and attribution
agents.role: Measures reach, saves, enquiries, consultations booked and cost per lead across organic and paid.

agents.name: Head of Content
agents.title: Content strategy and calendar
agents.task: Building the November to January calendar around the 31 January Self Assessment deadline.
agents.role: Turns research into a weekly content plan tied to the UK tax calendar and Ola offers.
agents.gate: Plan goes to the CEO, then to you for weekly sign-off.

agents.name: Copywriter EN + RO
agents.title: Hooks, scripts, captions
agents.task: Drafting 5 hooks for "MTD for Income Tax: what to do if you earn over £50k".
agents.role: Writes hooks, scripts, captions and posts in your voice, in English and Romanian.
agents.gate: Every piece goes to Compliance before you see it.

agents.name: Video Editor
agents.title: Edits, captions, motion
agents.task: Waiting for 2 MP4 uploads from your filming session.
agents.role: Edits raw footage into reels and shorts: cuts, captions, motion graphics, music, thumbnails, ad variants.
agents.gate: Licensed assets only. Never generates your face or voice without your sign-off.

agents.name: Head of Paid · Google Ads
agents.title: Search, Performance Max, YouTube
agents.task: Holds the paid budget: £100 Luton + £100 Birmingham in month 1, all on Meta. Google Search joins in month 2 at £200 per office.
agents.role: Leads Paid Media. Runs Google Ads (Search, Performance Max, YouTube) and keeps the Google Business Profile in sync. Sets the cross-channel budget split.
agents.gate: Spends only inside the monthly budget you approve. New campaigns, new audiences or budget rises above 20% need your approval. Every ad passes Compliance first. Targets by location, language and job role, never by ethnicity, nationality or other sensitive traits.

agents.name: Meta Ads Specialist
agents.title: Facebook + Instagram ads
agents.task: Two Click-to-WhatsApp campaigns ready to build: Luton £100 and Birmingham £100 for 30 days, Romanian language, 15 miles. Waiting for scripts A, B and C to be filmed.
agents.role: Plans and runs Facebook and Instagram campaigns: lead forms, retargeting video viewers, Romanian-language audiences.
agents.gate: Spends only inside the monthly budget you approve. New campaigns, new audiences or budget rises above 20% need your approval. Every ad passes Compliance first. Targets by location, language and job role, never by ethnicity, nationality or other sensitive traits.

agents.name: TikTok Ads Specialist
agents.title: Spark Ads and in-feed
agents.task: Boosting the "Payments on account explained" reel as a Spark Ad, £15/day test.
agents.role: Runs TikTok ads, mainly Spark Ads that boost Ola organic videos that already perform.
agents.gate: Spends only inside the monthly budget you approve. New campaigns, new audiences or budget rises above 20% need your approval. Every ad passes Compliance first. Targets by location, language and job role, never by ethnicity, nationality or other sensitive traits.

agents.name: LinkedIn & X Ads Specialist
agents.title: B2B: directors of Ltd companies
agents.task: LinkedIn Lead Gen Form for directors of 2–50 staff companies in Beds and West Midlands, £30/day.
agents.role: Runs LinkedIn and X campaigns aimed at directors and owners of limited companies.
agents.gate: Spends only inside the monthly budget you approve. New campaigns, new audiences or budget rises above 20% need your approval. Every ad passes Compliance first. Targets by location, language and job role, never by ethnicity, nationality or other sensitive traits.

agents.name: Compliance Reviewer
agents.title: Tax accuracy, CAP Code, PECR
agents.task: Checking 2 scripts and 1 Meta ad against GOV.UK MTD guidance and the CAP Code.
agents.role: Checks every tax claim, figure and deadline against official sources, plus advertising and email rules.
outputs: PASS, or fix list with sources
agents.gate: Can block any item. Only you can override.

agents.name: Publisher
agents.title: Scheduling on all channels
agents.task: 6 posts scheduled this week across Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, LinkedIn and X.
agents.role: Schedules approved content at the best time per channel and logs every post.
agents.gate: Can only publish items you approved.

agents.name: Publishing QA
agents.title: Checks every post went live
agents.task: Every hour, 07:12–23:12: checks each post on every network. If one failed, fixes the cause and reposts only that video on only that network.
agents.role: Safety layer after Publishing. Verifies that every scheduled post is live on every network, diagnoses errors, applies the known fix and reposts the specific item on the specific network. Escalates only what needs you (expired logins, account locks).
inputs: JPG and MP4 copies on GitHub
outputs: Reposts on the failed network only
Push alert when something was fixed or needs you
agents.gate: Never posts new content. Only reposts items you already approved, on the network where they failed, once. No duplicates.

agents.name: Lead Gen (Harvey)
agents.title: Ltd-company outreach
agents.task: 12 first-touch emails to Ltd companies in Luton waiting in the Outbox for your approval.
agents.role: Finds UK limited companies that fit Ola, studies their website and writes a personal 3-email sequence. Based on open-source Harvey.
agents.gate: Ltd companies only, checked on Companies House. Never sole traders or partnerships. Approval always on. Daily cap and unsubscribe in every email.

agents.name: Inbox & Booking
agents.title: DMs, replies, bookings
agents.task: 2 replies triaged; 1 consultation slot proposed for Thursday.
agents.role: Answers DMs, comments, lead forms and email replies, qualifies the enquiry and books the consultation.
agents.gate: Never gives tax advice or quotes fees beyond the published list. Hands over to an accountant.

agents.name: Head of Blog
agents.title: Website accuracy and weekly topic
agents.task: Every Monday 07:46: scans HMRC/GOV.UK changes of the week, audits the site for outdated facts, picks one topic, briefs the copywriter, reviews and opens ONE pull request with a Vercel preview for you to merge.
agents.role: Owns ola-accountancy.co.uk content. Finds what changed at HMRC and at Ola, fixes anything outdated on the site, chooses the weekly article topic and signs off the copywriter's draft. Opens one PR a week; never merges.
inputs: Site files: posts.ts, data.ts, prices, FAQs
outputs: Weekly PR (branch blog/<date>) with Vercel preview
agents.gate: Never merges or deploys. One PR per week, you click Merge. No design or layout changes. Fallback: Gmail draft for approval if GitHub access fails.

agents.name: Blog Copywriter
agents.title: One verified article a week
agents.task: Writes the article from the Head of Blog's brief: 900–1,500 words, UK English, posts.ts Block format, SEO title, excerpt and slug, ending with 'How Ola Accountancy can help' and the consultation CTA.
agents.role: Writes Ola's weekly blog article in UK English from the Head of Blog's brief, only with verified facts, in the site's Block format, SEO-ready.
agents.gate: No invented statistics, clients, testimonials or staff. Prices must match the site exactly. Draft goes back to the Head of Blog before the PR.
